title: isothermalFlash operation
description: Isothermal two-phase flash at fixed T and P. Both are optional overrides of the feed-stream conditions; omitting them flashes at the feed T and P.

T.title: Operating temperature
T.description: Override the feed temperature; if omitted, the flash uses the feed T.

P.title: Operating pressure
P.description: Override the feed pressure; if omitted, the flash uses the feed P.

phaseSet.title: Phase set
phaseSet.description: Which phases the flash is allowed to find. `auto` makes the phase set a RESULT rather than an input — the engine decides from what it already trusts and ANNOUNCES the set it chose, which is what the case dicts claimed all along while still making the author type it.

alphaRich.title: Component rich in the alpha liquid
alphaRich.description: Labels which of two liquids is which, for a liquid-liquid split. A label, not a constraint: it names the phases in the report without steering the Gibbs minimisation.

betaRich.title: Component rich in the beta liquid
